information.description:
The common muscle of Barghest’s forces, recruited from inexperienced shooters that show a shred of loyalty and not an ounce of morality. Lowest of the pack for sure, but still more equipped than a typical boosterganger.

From Corgo's 77 Collection: Mooks by Corgopolis (Barghest).
information.notes:
Threat level: Hardened Mook
Facedown #: 4
COM#: 12
Weapons: Choose one

Weapons:

  • SMG: ROF 1, 2d6 & Autofire (SMG 3). Typically a HA-7 Warden or M221 Saratoga (Civilian)
  • Heavy Pistol: ROF 2, 3d6 & Autofire (MP 3). Typically a HA-4 Grit or M-10AF Lexington

Armor:

  • Melee SP (head/body): 4/4

Not built:

description.value: Experts in combat who use their fighting prowess to dominate in the lawless time of the Red.
Standard Kevlar for your head. No armor penalty.
